faq.q: Can I convert SRT to VTT and back?
faq.a: Yes. The editor detects SRT or WebVTT input and you choose SRT, VTT or TXT as the export format. VTT export adds the WEBVTT header and dot-separated milliseconds.

faq.q: How does the timing shift work?
faq.a: Enter a positive number to delay every cue, or a negative number to move cues earlier, in seconds or milliseconds. Cues that would start before 0:00 are clamped and counted as an issue.

Cues need a timing line such as 00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000. If the text has no timing lines, use the TXT export or clean the file first.
